what: What the City of Cheyenne's own Granicus portal showed on the capture date, and what this project's live site showed on the same date. Recorded by hand from the pages named in each `source`, so that the comparison document can be regenerated and every claim in it can be re-checked against a URL.

views.title: City of Cheyenne Streaming Media Archive
views.rows: City Council / governing-body meetings only, most recent first
notes: Every row on this view is a City Council or governing-body meeting.
Older rows carry MP3 and MP4 links; the video column is an ASX stream that needs Windows Media Player.
Upcoming Events section reads “Currently there are no upcoming events.”

views.title: Redesign View
views.rows: City Council / governing-body meetings only, most recent first
notes: Page states Windows Media Player is required to view the videos.
Search form offers: Name & Description, Agenda Items, Attachment Items, Notes, Motions/Votes, Captions; all-words / exact phrase / any words / none of these words, plus a date range.
Rows run to 2008 on this view.

views.title: Civicplus View
views.rows: City Council / governing-body meetings only, most recent first
notes: Minutes links carry a doc_id; there is no direct MP3/MP4 column on this view.
Verified rows run from Oct 26, 2026 back to Feb 9, 2026 in the page we read; this view is shorter than views 2 and 4.
RSS feeds offered: agendas, minutes, podcast, video podcast.

views.title: OpenCities View
views.rows: City Council / governing-body meetings only, most recent first
notes: Same content as view 5, rendered for the OpenCities template.
Verified rows run from Oct 26, 2026 back to Jan 26, 2026 in the page we read.

views.title: Training
views.rows: Vendor training recordings, not public meetings
notes: Eight rows, all Granicus staff training calls (LiveManager, Peak, Drafter/Approver), plus one City Council row from Mar 7, 2023.
This archive's video catalog includes these clips too, so its 481-clip count is not all meetings.
